reviews.text: Returning customer to this place and they are truly amazing. They do an amazing job washing cats and they smell amazing afterwards too. Will definitely be back

I can confirm the same happened to me. Based on other reviews, my cat was also left in this horrible place. If it’s your cat’s first time at a groomer, do not waste your time bringing them here.

My cat has been groomed before by a highly professional cat groomer, so I know he is calm, well-behaved, and not aggressive. The staff here handled the situation very poorly. Not only did they return my cat without grooming him, but they also exposed him to dogs and then blamed my cat for their inability to complete the groom.

It seems quite obvious that they lack the experience and skills needed to handle cats properly. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a professional and stress-free grooming experience for their cat. Avoid.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

What an incredible experience! We weren’t even there with a dog. I was visiting with four children, and Igor, Sarah, Gaby, and Dry were unbelievably kind and generous with their time.

They welcomed us so warmly and made what could have been a quick visit into such a special experience. They let the children meet the dogs, watch them being groomed and bathed, give them treats, learn about their care, and explore the shop. Every single member of the team was so patient, friendly, and genuinely passionate about animals.

The joy on the children’s faces was priceless. It became one of the highlights of our day, and they haven’t stopped talking about it since.

Thank you, Igor, Sarah, Gaby, and Dry, for your kindness, generosity, and for creating such a welcoming place. You didn’t have to go out of your way for us, but you did, and it meant so much. We cannot recommend The Pet Spa highly enough. ❤️🐾 I’ve never had an experience like this before !
Best pet grooming in London!!!

My dogs have been so many groomers but this place is the best one ever. I couldn’t recommend enough. They never shave my toy poodle even though when she is matted. My Labrador doesn’t like blow dry and they patiently make her dry.

Really, really disappointing... I'd booked my long-haired cat in for a trim (the hot weather is getting to him), confirmed it, and left him there in some trepidation (he's shy and it was his first time). I got halfway back home and was called and told that the groomer wouldn't be able to trim him as she'd been scratched by the previous feline customer. Isn't the odd scratch part of the job? And even if it isn't, I'd literally just been in the shop! I won't be returning. Terrible customer service.
Outstanding service and facilities. Would use again in a heart beat
Great service and friendly staff. My cats are always well cared for and come home happy. Highly recommend!
Best groomers we've found and our cat loves them too!!

Walked in and was interested to buy some bowls for my dog,but apparently even though a member of staff was right there chatting even after a few minutes he refused to approach and give any service at all,i left and no one even looked at me. Have not idea how good it is this place because i was not given any service at all and was completely ignored

I have used Pet Spa a few times and have never had any issues, they’ve always done a good job, however I took my cat for a haircut last week like I have done for a while now and when he returned home I noticed a cut on the back of his neck with a obvious recent wound. I emailed them to ask what had happened attaching photos and the reply I got was just a denial and suggestion that this is an old wound and that I should just give my cat a hug from them. The person who emailed me was not giving a name and was extremely rude when I replied with additional photos showing the cut, but I was met with an equally rude response basically saying if I was not happy that I should take my cat elsewhere in the future. They have still not given me their name or the name and email of the owner of the company so I can contact them. I know if I owned a company like this I would want to be informed if a staff member was being so rude and flippant towards a client. All I wanted was an acknowledgment of what had happened and an apology, nothing more, but all I got was denials and rudeness.
I would suggest thinking twice before taking your pet to this establishment, I will not be going there again unless I get an apology from them.
A very good spa for cats I recommend for sure !

Update over 1 year later :
Rex has been groomed exclusively at the pet spa, I take him in every 3-4 weeks, his coat is exceptional, all staff know him by name, he is always happy to go in and not anxious AT ALL.

After months of struggling to find the right groomer for our high maintenance and fuzzy beautiful Persian cat, I’m happy to share that we have found the perfect place. Igor and the whole team were so welcoming and informed us that Freddie was so well behaved! Something that the rest of the groomers would always struggle telling us that he was too difficult and charging us more for it…The Pet Spa managed to not only bath him but also shave him as he was so matted. Thank you so much we are going to come back regularly !!!

I’ve been bringing my dog here since I first got him, and I’ve always been extremely happy with the service but today I’m especially grateful. He had been wearing a cone for the past two weeks and ended up with a lot of matting in his ears. I thought shaving him would be the only solution. However, with so much patience, care, and love, they were able to save his fur instead.

I’m beyond thankful for the amazing job they did. I highly recommend them! They truly are the best and genuinely care about what they do. <3

Do not waste your money or time; it is terrible grooming and unprofessional. I was offered a second visit to redo the job, but I couldn't attend due to time constraints. Check prices, confirm the job is done, and ask for an invoice. They charge you for an unitemised bill. Our cocker spaniel is a mess.

The way you cut my Pomeranian is absolutely unforgivable. I asked for a light trim, specifically mentioning that I love his coat, and he came back completely unrecognisable - super short, with shaved parts. The woman who did it should never touch a Pomeranian ever again. I’m shocked and disgusted by your negligence.

WARNING! Absolutely horrible experience at Pet Spa!

We had to find a new grooming salon for our cat after moving, and unfortunately ended up at Pet Spa. BIG MISTAKE.

When we picked up our cat today, I was horrified to see that one of his claws had been completely ripped out!!! The staff gave some pathetic excuse, saying he was "scratching the table while drying." Really?! We’ve groomed our cat many times at other salons — NEVER once has he been injured!

What  were they doing to him?! This is pure negligence and completely unacceptable. You clearly don’t know how to handle animals properly. This was our first and DEFINITELY last visit. I’m furious and heartbroken.

DO NOT trust this place with your pets!
